# 📊 Results

This directory stores output files generated by the pipeline.

## Generated Files

After running `python main.py`, you will find:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `model_comparison.png` | Time-series prediction plots (ML + DL models) |
| `metrics_comparison.png` | Bar chart comparing MAE, RMSE, R² across models |
| `model_results.csv` | Tabular results for all metrics and models |

## Regenerating Results

All files here are regenerable:

```bash
python main.py
```
